title: France within a month: Dr. Chavron and the 'Helen Comes Back' session
summary: A month later she was in France for her first time in that way, meeting Dr. Chavron, touring for Monestier and recording for Black and Blue with Milt Buckner and Jay McShann, who was in good form.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
